name: lemure;lemure
source:
A string of serial murders sends the Whitechapel district of Londinium into a fearful frenzy. Amidst those blood colored whispers, a white cat continues her daily life in the slums doing odd jobs and nothing of note.

Then, one day—as if ordained by God— she meets her fated lover: a dirty, dirty liar. 

[From [url=https://4noki.itch.io/lemure-lemure]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一系列连环谋杀案让伦敦的白教堂区陷入了可怕的疯狂之中。在血色的低语声中，一只白猫在贫民窟里继续着自己的日常生活，做着一些不起眼的零工。

然后，有一天——仿佛是上帝注定的——她遇到了她命中注定的情人：一个肮脏、肮脏的骗子。

[来自[url=https://4noki.itch.io/lemure-lemure]itch.io[/url]]
